summary: Pakistani organizations should prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities, particularly CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and have been added to the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors including Microsoft and Google. The recent surge in zero-day exploits, including CVE-2026-72898 and CVE-2026-8037, poses a significant threat to local networks, and immediate attention is required to mitigate these risks. Pakistani CERT has issued alerts PKCERT-917CDA37 and PKCERT-78CA5DA2, warning of targeted attacks against local entities, and organizations should take immediate action to review their security controls and apply necessary patches to prevent potential breaches.
